title: 1589 save asset
body:
Fixes #1589 

The `Save` event was pushing a cloned copy of the `forces` object into the database, then using this cloned object in the client state.

But, the `selected asset` was an object from the `original` force.  So, when we store changes to that asset, it doesn't change the original.

Now, when a new `force` is received, we update the `selected item` to point to a valid item.

issues.title: Can't always SAVE asset name changes
issues.body:
I'm playing around with the `Forces` page in `develop` branch.

On most occasions, changing an asset name does not get stored in the database.  It keeps the old name.

My _guess_ is that `setSelectedItem` isn't looking at the "real" object, but is looking at a `copy`.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/d82f1fdf0d80fb2d3b62721b4bf5da14.gif)
